summary: Opt-in transaction finalization and explicit view-unavailability for source adapters

replay.detail: No source replay, automatic initializer or production IVM activation.

schema.detail: Adds no database tables, triggers or schema version changes.

rules.detail: Admission, canonical ordering and checkpoint rules are unchanged.

compatibility.detail: Managed WriterGuard transactions now return WriterTransaction; commit returns anyhow::Result with the original cause. Default writer behavior has no finalizer.

downtime.detail: No deployment or restart required by the library change.

manual.detail: An adopter explicitly installs one bounded callback and proves complete source capture, including independent fencing for raw connection and autocommit bypasses.

recovery.detail: Finalizer errors roll back source and derived writes together; a second installation is refused. Restore and coverage recovery remain source-adapter responsibilities.
